title: CotoPay
role: Concept, brand system, homepage design & launch animations
desc: A self-initiated rebrand and launch concept for CotoPay’s purpose-locked UPI vouchers.
lead: I created an unsolicited rebrand and launch concept for CotoPay: a brand system, a homepage and a set of launch animations built around one line, “Company money, spent on UPI.”
body: CotoPay issues purpose-locked UPI vouchers on NPCI e-RUPI, with ICICI Bank. A company can lock a voucher to a category, a brand or a single outlet. Employees pay with the UPI app they already have, with no new app and no per-employee KYC. Unused money never leaves the company account.
detail: I wanted the product to make sense in one look. The homepage leads with the promise, then shows a voucher being issued, received, paid and reconciled. The launch animations take one idea each: spend locks, scanning a QR, the ledger and real use cases such as fleet fuel.
captions: Use cases launch film — fleet fuel, petty cash and allowances
From issued to reconciled — launch animation
Homepage hero — “Company money, spent on UPI.”
How it works — issue, receive, pay, reconcile
Spend locks — category, brand or outlet
Comparison with prepaid cards and wallets

story.challenge: Explain a new kind of company payment, purpose-locked UPI vouchers, to fleet owners and finance teams in a few seconds.
decisions: Lead with one plain promise: “Company money, spent on UPI.”
Show the voucher’s life in four steps: issue, receive, pay and reconcile.
Give every launch animation a single idea, from spend locks to fleet fuel.
story.result: A brand system, homepage design and a set of launch social animations, shared as a self-initiated concept.

context: Self-initiated concept · unsolicited rebrand & launch · not client work
contribution: Shaped the concept and the core message.
Designed the brand system and the homepage.
summary: A self-initiated rebrand and launch concept for CotoPay, which issues purpose-locked UPI vouchers on NPCI e-RUPI with ICICI Bank. Vouchers lock by category, brand or outlet, with no new app or per-employee KYC, and unused money never leaves the company account.
